_comment: Mission Control rules. Override or extend any list in the gitignored config/missioncontrol.local.json (same shape; lists there REPLACE the lists here). Rules are plain-language instructions handed to the mail model; senders are exact addresses or @domains.

trashCategories: Marketing and promotional email: sales, discounts, coupons, 'last chance' offers, product launches from shops and brands
Newsletters and digests the user never replied to (Substack, Medium daily digest, product/company newsletters, blog roundups)

Social network notifications that are not a message from a person: LinkedIn notifications (views, 'people you may know', job alerts, post likes), Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, YouTube, Reddit, Discord digests
Automated app or service notices that need no action: 'welcome' mails, feature announcements, tips and onboarding series, terms-of-service updates, 'we miss you' mails
Shipping and delivery updates for orders that were already delivered or are older than 7 days
One-time login codes, verification codes and magic links older than 24 hours
Webinar, conference and event invitations from companies, plus surveys and 'rate your experience' requests
Successful CI / build / deploy notifications and dependency-bot digests (failures are NOT in this category)
flagCategories: Payment failures, declined cards, failed renewals
Double or unexpected charges, refunds that did not arrive
Security alerts about unknown sign-ins, new devices or password changes the user may not have made
Leaked credential, exposed secret or API-key notices (GitHub secret scanning, GitGuardian, provider key leaks), and any mail containing plaintext passwords, logins or API keys
Account-access actions that need a response: verify your account, confirm ownership, account will be suspended or deleted
Domain, certificate or subscription expiry warnings
Tax, government or legal mail (e.g. Urzad Skarbowy, ZUS, e-Urzad, courts, notaries)
Failed CI / build / deploy runs on the user's own repositories
neverTrash: Real human correspondence: personal messages, replies in a thread with a real person, LinkedIn messages written by a person
Invoices, receipts and faktury (needed for accounting)
Anything the user sent or replied to
